structure: Part 8 read in full every non-unit-test file in three feature folders of src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features: origin/ (page.js, controller.js, evaluation.js, validate.js, template.njk, copy/copy.en.js, copy/copy.cy.js, origin.fit.spec.js), import-reason/ (the same set, with import-reason.fit.spec.js) and additional-details/ (the same set, with additional-details.fit.spec.js). The controller.test.js, validate.test.js and copy.test.js unit tests were left out, as the part says. It covers three pages, each marked agreed. The origin page (slug origin) has a country-of-origin type-ahead over a native select, a Yes/No region of origin code question that reveals a prefixed five-character code box, and an optional internal reference. It offers Save and continue only, which goes on to the commodities question. The main import reason page (slug import-reason) has one radio question of five reasons, with reveals: a purpose radio list for internal market, a destination country for transhipment, a port of exit then a destination country for transit, an MOJ date picker then a port for temporary admission of horses, and nothing for re-entry. It offers Save and continue (to commodities) and Save and return to overview. The additional details page (slug additional-details) asks the certification purpose and, only when the commodities put it in scope, the unweaned animals Yes/No. It offers both save actions, and Save and continue goes to the port of entry. The part claims the routes, headings, captions, fields, hints, options, reveals, validation messages verbatim, save behaviour, back links, Welsh key parity, what the three fit specs prove and the gaps where labels or list sources sit outside the slice. The slice is unchanged since the earlier extract apart from an internal rename of the exit date reader, so every kept claim still holds.

claims.statement: The additional details page asks 'What are the animals certified for?', hinted 'You can find this information on the ITAHC.'
The certification question's options are the certification purposes the certification-purposes service lists, in its order, one of which is Slaughter.

The wording of each certification option's radio label, beyond 'Slaughter', is not held by the page: it comes from the certification-purposes service, so the full list a user reads cannot be read from this feature.
claims.note: Looked in additional-details/copy/copy.en.js, which holds only the legend, hint and one error, and in controller.js, which spreads the service's option objects. The labels live in src/server/app/services/certification-purposes, outside this part's read; only 'Slaughter' is named, by the fit spec.
